what: The live page in a real browser tab (the same tab as D4 and Q2): 'Wake the mind' pressed, which loaded WebLLM 0.2.79 from esm.run and Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-q4f16_1-MLC from Hugging Face's mlc-ai repository (about 700 MB, once), then 'Route the 70 sealed messages' pressed: each message sent once with the sealed prompt and options, every reply read through the mind's door (core/mind.mjs). This is the tab's own window.p5.m3, copied as it was.
browser: Chrome/152.0.7977.167 (the Claude desktop app's browser pane), WebGPU
why: 30 of the 70 replies were not a proposal. In WebLLM's JSON mode this 4-bit build begins the sealed reply, {"route":"…", and then keeps writing fields it was not asked for (a description, steps, made-up prices, made-up partner names) until the sealed 24-token limit cuts it off mid-string, so the reply is not JSON and the mind's door refuses it; the keyword rule then decides. The same model, 8-bit, under Ollama's JSON mode, stopped at the route (M2). Nothing the model wrote in those extra fields reached the page.
